_ConnectionStrings_note: Passwords are injected at runtime (ConnectionStrings__Producer / ConnectionStrings__Admin via env var / user-secrets); never committed. Producer = pol_app (RLS-scoped, tenant-facing, the default path). Admin = pol_admin (RLS-bypass) used ONLY by the cross-tenant provisioning endpoints (POST/GET /admin/tenants).
_Google_note: One API, many SPAs: map each role to that SPA's Google OAuth client id — every value is an accepted token audience and becomes the caller's role claim. Set per env via Google__Audiences__tenant / Google__Audiences__admin.
_Cors_note: Browser SPA frontend origins. Empty here (no cross-origin allowed); set per env via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 / __1.
